description: Operational E2E Contract Matrix for Interactive HTML Content Onboarding (Future Contract Model)

cases.preconditions: Content Manager session active, target subject and lesson exist in draft container
cases.input: Valid Excel metadata sheet (lesson_id, title, resource_type=mind_map_html) + valid ZIP archive containing index.html, styles.css, script.js, asset images, manifest.json
steps: Upload Excel metadata sheet to ingestion specification endpoint
Upload ZIP archive matching package code
Validate archive structure and manifest SHA-256 digest
Stage assets in temporary staging bucket
cases.expected_result: Package accepted with HTTP 201 Created, status set to draft, SHA-256 registered, staged without errors
cases.security_invariant: SEC-PKG-01: Package must pass zip-slip, symlink, and checksum validation before staging
cases.evidence_required: Ingestion audit log entry, calculated bundle SHA-256 digest, staging directory file inventory receipt
cleanup_steps: delete test import batch by batch_code
remove staging prefix owned by batch

cases.preconditions: Content Manager session active, practical experiment schema active
cases.input: Valid HTML5 practical experiment simulation bundle (resource_type=practical_experiment_html) using Canvas 2D / WebGL with reset handler
steps: Upload experiment simulation bundle
Validate offline asset manifest completeness
Verify postMessage event protocol specification compliance
cases.expected_result: Package validated and registered as practical_experiment_html in draft status, checksum locked for review
cases.security_invariant: SEC-PKG-02: Experiments must expose standardized postMessage interface for state saving without direct localStorage access
cases.evidence_required: postMessage contract verification log, isolated canvas render snapshot
cleanup_steps: delete test import batch by batch_code
remove staging prefix owned by batch

cases.preconditions: Package ingestion endpoint pre-extraction security filter enabled
cases.input: ZIP archive containing path traversal entry header '../../etc/passwd' or compression ratio exceeding 100:1 (Zip Bomb)
steps: Submit malformed ZIP archive to upload stream
Trigger archive header pre-unzip inspection
Verify extraction termination before disk write
cases.expected_result: Package rejected with HTTP 400 Bad Request and error code UNSAFE_ZIP_ARCHIVE_REJECTED, 0 bytes extracted
cases.security_invariant: SEC-ZIP-01: Absolute path traversal, relative parent escapes, and compression bomb ratios must be blocked before decompression
cases.evidence_required: Security scanner alert log, extraction rejection stack trace, zero-file write confirmation log

cases.preconditions: ZIP stream directory header inspector enabled
cases.input: ZIP archive containing symlink file header pointing to '/etc/shadow' or 'C:\Windows\System32\config\SAM'
steps: Scan ZIP central directory headers
Check file system entry attribute flags for symbolic/hard link mode bits
Abort extraction upon link flag detection
cases.expected_result: HTTP 400 rejection with error code SYMLINK_TRAVERSAL_REJECTED, extraction aborted immediately
cases.security_invariant: SEC-FS-01: Symbolic links, hard links, and directory traversal tokens ('../') in entry paths are prohibited
cases.evidence_required: Zip header inspection audit log with symlink entry metadata details
cleanup_steps: remove staging prefix owned by batch

cases.preconditions: Static HTML/JS AST security validator active in upload preflight
cases.input: ZIP package with index.html containing '<script src="https://cdn.external-domain.com/malicious.js"></script>' or remote fetch calls
steps: Parse index.html DOM and script references
Inspect script tag src attributes and inline dynamic fetch/XHR URIs
Evaluate against strict origin CSP whitelist policy
cases.expected_result: Validation failure with error code EXTERNAL_JS_NOT_ALLOWED, package upload rejected
cases.security_invariant: SEC-JS-01: Remote JavaScript scripts, external CDN links, and external dynamic imports are strictly forbidden; all assets must be bundled internally
cases.evidence_required: Static AST analyzer violation report listing forbidden URI line number
cleanup_steps: remove staging prefix owned by batch

cases.preconditions: CSP hash verification engine enabled for HTML asset packages
cases.input: ZIP package containing index.html with inline scripts not matching declared script-src SHA-256 hashes in manifest
steps: Compute cryptographic hashes of inline script tags in index.html
Compare inline script hashes against declared CSP manifest hashes
Flag inline script hash mismatch during package scanning
cases.expected_result: Package upload rejected with HTTP 400 and error code INVALID_CSP_HASH_REJECTED
cases.security_invariant: SEC-CSP-01: All inline HTML scripts must match strict SHA-256 CSP hashes declared in package manifest
cases.evidence_required: CSP hash audit report showing computed vs expected SHA-256 hashes
cleanup_steps: remove staging prefix owned by batch

cases.preconditions: Package content analyzer active for interactive question and assessment packages
cases.input: ZIP bundle containing embedded answer key files, plaintext answer JSON, or answer key content inside HTML package
steps: Perform deep payload inspection on package files
Scan JS/JSON for plaintext answer structures or solution key constants
Reject upload if raw answer key content is discovered inside client bundle
cases.expected_result: Package rejected with HTTP 400 and error code ANSWER_KEY_BUNDLE_DENIED
cases.security_invariant: SEC-ANS-01: Answer key data and evaluation solution arrays are strictly prohibited inside client-facing HTML packages
cases.evidence_required: Content inspection report detailing detected solution key payload line
cleanup_steps: remove staging prefix owned by batch

cases.preconditions: Question bank rendering security scanner active
cases.input: Interactive content package containing question metadata where questions.correct_index is embedded in client HTML script
steps: Parse package HTML and script content
Verify absence of questions.correct_index in client DOM and bundle variables
Ensure evaluation logic relies exclusively on server-side validation
cases.expected_result: Package rejected with error CORRECT_INDEX_LEAKAGE_DENIED if questions.correct_index reaches client HTML
cases.security_invariant: SEC-KEY-01: The questions.correct_index field must never be exposed to or rendered within client HTML or JavaScript bundles
cases.evidence_required: AST scanner report confirming zero occurrences of correct_index in client bundle
cleanup_steps: remove staging prefix owned by batch

cases.preconditions: Explanation reveal protection module enabled
cases.input: Interactive experiment or assessment package containing question explanation texts
steps: Analyze HTML DOM structure and script state
Verify explanation content is withheld until student submits valid answer
Confirm explanation text is omitted from initial page payload
cases.expected_result: Explanation content is not present in initial DOM/bundle and is accessible only after explicit server reveal signal
cases.security_invariant: SEC-EXP-01: Answer explanations must not reach client DOM or network payload before explicit reveal criteria are met
cases.evidence_required: Initial DOM payload snapshot proving explanation text is absent before reveal
cleanup_steps: remove staging prefix owned by batch

cases.preconditions: PII scanner enabled for package uploads
cases.input: Content package containing student personal identifiable information (PII) like emails, student IDs, or names in local storage or bundle state
steps: Scan uploaded package assets for embedded PII patterns
Check default bundle initialization for personal data storage routines
Block package if PII collection or persistence is detected
cases.expected_result: Package upload rejected with HTTP 400 and error STUDENT_PII_IN_PACKAGE_DENIED
cases.security_invariant: SEC-PII-01: Student PII must never enter or be stored within content package bundles
cases.evidence_required: PII detector report verifying zero personal identifiers in bundle
cleanup_steps: remove staging prefix owned by batch

cases.preconditions: Unauthenticated HTTP session (no Authorization header)
cases.input: HTTP GET/POST requests to administrative endpoints /api/v1/admin/content/*
steps: Send request to admin content endpoint without bearer token
Evaluate gateway authentication guard
Verify immediate access denial
cases.expected_result: Request denied with HTTP 401 Unauthorized or 403 Forbidden
cases.security_invariant: SEC-AUTH-01: Administrative routes require valid authenticated session token
cases.evidence_required: HTTP 401/403 gateway response log showing unauthenticated rejection

cases.preconditions: Unauthenticated user session
cases.input: Direct HTTP GET request to private draft resource URL or storage path
steps: Attempt to fetch draft resource asset as unauthenticated user
Check storage and application authorization guards
cases.expected_result: Request denied with HTTP 401 Unauthorized or HTTP 404 Not Found
cases.security_invariant: SEC-AUTH-02: Private draft resources are strictly inaccessible to unauthenticated users
cases.evidence_required: HTTP response payload verifying access denial

cases.preconditions: Active student token session
cases.input: Student request to admin endpoint POST /api/v1/admin/content/publish
steps: Issue administrative POST request using student bearer token
Evaluate role permission matrix at API gateway
cases.expected_result: Request denied with HTTP 403 Forbidden
cases.security_invariant: SEC-RBAC-01: Student role is strictly barred from accessing administrative routes
cases.evidence_required: HTTP 403 authorization refusal response log

cases.preconditions: HTML content item in draft or in_review or approved status
cases.input: Student requests lesson contents GET /api/v1/lessons/{id}/contents
steps: Authenticate as student user
Issue query for lesson contents
Inspect returned content array
cases.expected_result: Draft, in_review, and approved items remain hidden from student; payload omits non-published items
cases.security_invariant: SEC-VIS-01: Student endpoints must strictly return items in published lifecycle state
cases.evidence_required: API response payload verifying complete exclusion of non-published items

cases.preconditions: Student enrolled in Lesson A, resource belongs to Lesson B
cases.input: Student attempts to fetch published content resource belonging to Lesson B via direct API or URL
steps: Authenticate as student assigned to Lesson A
Request resource bound to Lesson B
Evaluate resource-to-lesson enrollment check
cases.expected_result: Request denied with HTTP 403 Forbidden or 404 Not Found (wrong lesson access denied)
cases.security_invariant: SEC-LESSON-01: Students cannot access content resources belonging to lessons outside their active enrollment
cases.evidence_required: Authorization failure log showing lesson scope mismatch

cases.preconditions: Student has active user session but can_access_lesson flag is set to false
cases.input: Student requests content item for a lesson where can_access_lesson is false
steps: Authenticate as student
Set lesson entitlement flag can_access_lesson=false
Request content item API
Verify entitlement gate response
cases.expected_result: Request denied with HTTP 403 Forbidden due to can_access_lesson=false entitlement failure
cases.security_invariant: SEC-LESSON-02: Content access requires explicit can_access_lesson boolean entitlement flag set to true
cases.evidence_required: Entitlement check decision log returning false

cases.preconditions: User session with role content_manager
cases.input: POST /api/v1/content/{id}/publish or POST /api/v1/content/{id}/approve request
steps: Authenticate as content_manager
Submit publication or approval request to admin endpoint
Evaluate separation of duties policy
cases.expected_result: Request denied with HTTP 403 INSUFFICIENT_PERMISSIONS; content_manager cannot approve or publish
cases.security_invariant: SEC-RBAC-02: Content managers can upload and submit for review but cannot approve or publish content
cases.evidence_required: HTTP 403 authorization log showing content_manager publish/approve rejection
cleanup_steps: delete test import batch by batch_code

cases.preconditions: Database Row Level Security (RLS) policies active
cases.input: Direct database SQL insert/update attempt or unprivileged connection write
steps: Attempt direct write query to content table as application role
Evaluate DB row level security rules
cases.expected_result: Direct table write denied by RLS policy constraint
cases.security_invariant: SEC-DB-01: Direct database table writes are strictly prohibited; all state mutations must pass through validated backend logic
cases.evidence_required: Database RLS violation log

cases.preconditions: Storage bucket access controls active
cases.input: Direct storage upload request to production published bucket prefix
steps: Attempt direct file write to published storage bucket prefix
Evaluate bucket IAM write permissions
cases.expected_result: Direct write denied with HTTP 403 Storage Access Denied
cases.security_invariant: SEC-STRG-01: Direct writes to published storage buckets are forbidden without verified admin publish workflow
cases.evidence_required: Storage access denial audit log

cases.preconditions: Signed URL signer service active
cases.input: Request to generate signed access URL for item in draft or in_review state
steps: Request signed URL for non-published content asset
Evaluate lifecycle state validator before signing
cases.expected_result: Signed URL request denied with HTTP 400/403; signed URLs issued for published state items only
cases.security_invariant: SEC-SURL-01: Signed storage URLs cannot be generated for unpublished content assets
cases.evidence_required: Signed URL generator rejection log

cases.preconditions: HTML content item exists in draft status
cases.input: Submit for review request POST /api/v1/content/{id}/submit-review
steps: Authenticate as content_manager
Execute submit for review request
Verify state transition
cases.expected_result: Lifecycle status transitions atomically from draft to in_review, audit record logged
cases.security_invariant: SEC-WF-01: Transition draft -> in_review requires valid content_manager submission
cases.evidence_required: State transition log showing draft -> in_review
cleanup_steps: delete test import batch by batch_code

cases.preconditions: HTML content item status is in_review
cases.input: Approval request POST /api/v1/content/{id}/approve with review notes
steps: Authenticate as admin
Inspect in_review content package
Submit approval request
cases.expected_result: Lifecycle status transitions from in_review to approved, audit record created
cases.security_invariant: SEC-WF-02: Transition in_review -> approved requires admin role approval
cases.evidence_required: State transition database audit record showing in_review -> approved
cleanup_steps: delete test import batch by batch_code

cases.preconditions: HTML content item status is in_review
cases.input: Rejection request POST /api/v1/content/{id}/reject with rejection reason
steps: Authenticate as admin
Submit rejection request with rejection reason feedback
Verify state transition
cases.expected_result: Lifecycle status transitions from in_review to rejected
cases.security_invariant: SEC-WF-03: Transition in_review -> rejected requires admin role rejection with reason
cases.evidence_required: Audit log entry recording rejection event and notes
cleanup_steps: delete test import batch by batch_code

cases.preconditions: HTML content item status is rejected
cases.input: Update request POST /api/v1/content/{id}/re-edit with updated package ZIP
steps: Authenticate as content_manager
Upload updated package ZIP for rejected item
Transition status back to draft
cases.expected_result: Lifecycle status transitions from rejected back to draft for revision
cases.security_invariant: SEC-WF-04: Transition rejected -> draft allowed for content_manager upon package revision
cases.evidence_required: Audit trail log recording rejected -> draft transition
cleanup_steps: delete test import batch by batch_code

cases.preconditions: HTML content item status is approved
cases.input: Publication request POST /api/v1/content/{id}/publish
steps: Authenticate as admin
Verify item status is approved
Execute publish command
cases.expected_result: Lifecycle status transitions from approved to published, distribution cache updated
cases.security_invariant: SEC-WF-05: Transition approved -> published restricted strictly to admin role
cases.evidence_required: Publication audit record and status change event

cases.preconditions: HTML content item is currently in published status
cases.input: Unpublish request POST /api/v1/content/{id}/unpublish
steps: Authenticate as admin
Execute unpublish command
Query student content API
cases.expected_result: Lifecycle status transitions from published back to approved; student access revoked immediately
cases.security_invariant: SEC-WF-06: Transition published -> approved via unpublish immediately revokes student distribution
cases.evidence_required: Unpublish audit record and student API 404 payload proof

cases.preconditions: HTML content item status is draft or in_review or rejected (not approved)
cases.input: Direct publish request POST /api/v1/content/{id}/publish
steps: Authenticate as admin
Attempt to publish item that is in draft/in_review/rejected status
Evaluate state machine rule
cases.expected_result: Publish request rejected with HTTP 400 UNAPPROVED_PUBLISH_DENIED; only approved items can be published
cases.security_invariant: SEC-WF-07: Unapproved content (draft, in_review, rejected) cannot be published under any role
cases.evidence_required: State machine refusal log showing invalid transition attempt
cleanup_steps: delete test import batch by batch_code

cases.preconditions: Version v2.0 is published, previous version v1.0 is archived
cases.input: Rollback request POST /api/v1/content/{id}/rollback with target_version='v1.0'
steps: Authenticate as admin
Execute rollback to v1.0
Verify active pointer and SHA-256 digest match v1.0
cases.expected_result: Active published version pointer restored to v1.0, v2.0 status set to archived, audit event logged
cases.security_invariant: SEC-VER-01: Rollback atomically restores verified historical version and updates active state to approved/published
cases.evidence_required: Pointer update log and SHA-256 digest match receipt

cases.preconditions: Two concurrent admin sessions open on same approved content item
cases.input: Simultaneous POST /api/v1/content/{id}/publish requests from Admin A and Admin B
steps: Issue concurrent publish requests
Process optimistic lock check on lock_version field
cases.expected_result: One publish request succeeds (200 OK); concurrent request fails with HTTP 409 CONCURRENT_PUBLISH_CONFLICT
cases.security_invariant: SEC-LOCK-01: Concurrent state modifications must be guarded by optimistic lock version checks
cases.evidence_required: HTTP 409 Conflict response log for losing transaction

cases.preconditions: Content item lock_version has incremented to 5
cases.input: Publish request submitted with stale lock_version=4
steps: Send publish payload containing stale lock_version
Evaluate lock version equality check
cases.expected_result: Request denied with HTTP 409 STALE_LOCK_VERSION_DENIED
cases.security_invariant: SEC-LOCK-02: State updates with stale lock_version parameter must be rejected
cases.evidence_required: Lock version mismatch error log

cases.preconditions: Idempotency header requirement active for upload endpoints
cases.input: Retry upload POST request with duplicate Idempotency-Key header 'REQ-99201' and identical payload
steps: Send initial upload with Idempotency-Key: REQ-99201
Send identical retry with same Idempotency-Key
Compare responses
cases.expected_result: Retry returns cached initial result (HTTP 201) without duplicating database records or storage allocation
cases.security_invariant: SEC-IDEMP-01: Duplicate requests with matching Idempotency-Key must return identical deterministic response without side effects
cases.evidence_required: Idempotency key hit audit log
cleanup_steps: delete test import batch by batch_code

cases.preconditions: Multi-file upload stream active
cases.input: Network disconnect occurs mid-transfer after transmitting partial ZIP stream
steps: Simulate network loss during stream upload
Trigger upload timeout handler
Run cleanup transaction sweeper
cases.expected_result: Upload aborted, partial temp files deleted atomically, zero orphan storage objects left
cases.security_invariant: SEC-RES-01: Interrupted uploads must execute atomic cleanup and leave zero persistent orphan objects
cases.evidence_required: Storage audit log verifying 0 orphan objects after aborted upload
cleanup_steps: remove staging prefix owned by batch

cases.preconditions: Manifest specifies expected SHA-256 package hash
cases.input: Altered ZIP package where computed SHA-256 does not match manifest hash
steps: Compute SHA-256 of uploaded package
Compare computed hash with manifest hash
Block publish/staging if mismatch
cases.expected_result: Upload/Publish rejected with HTTP 400 HASH_MISMATCH_BLOCKS_PUBLISH
cases.security_invariant: SEC-TMP-01: Hash mismatch between package payload and manifest blocks staging and publication
cases.evidence_required: Cryptographic hash mismatch error log
cleanup_steps: remove staging prefix owned by batch

cases.preconditions: Student conducting interactive practical experiment
cases.input: Forged postMessage or un-signed HTTP request POST /api/v1/progress/complete with score=100 without HMAC signature
steps: Receive experiment completion telemetry event
Validate HMAC signature against active session secret
cases.expected_result: Completion event rejected with error FORGED_EXPERIMENT_COMPLETION_DENIED; lesson completion not granted
cases.security_invariant: SEC-TMP-02: Interactive completion events must carry valid HMAC token signature issued by backend
cases.evidence_required: HMAC validation rejection security log

cases.preconditions: Iframe postMessage replay prevention active
cases.input: Replay of previously processed iframe postMessage event or stale nonce
steps: Receive postMessage event with expired timestamp or reused nonce
Check replay detection cache
cases.expected_result: Event rejected with error STALE_IFRAME_EVENT_DENIED
cases.security_invariant: SEC-TMP-03: Replayed or stale iframe postMessage events must be rejected
cases.evidence_required: Replay detector refusal audit log

cases.preconditions: Mobile app WebView runtime launch attempt
cases.input: Request to execute HTML asset in mobile WebView
steps: Intercept mobile WebView launch request
Verify WebView isolation flags (allow-same-origin removed)
Check native runtime feature flag
cases.expected_result: Execution remains disabled with error NATIVE_RUNTIME_DISABLED until full sandbox isolation proof is verified
cases.security_invariant: SEC-ISO-01: Native runtime integrations are disabled until strict sandbox isolation is verified
cases.evidence_required: WebView security capability report and feature flag block proof

cases.preconditions: Orphan object reconciliation sweeper active
cases.input: Routine storage bucket sweep for unreferenced asset files
steps: Scan storage prefixes for orphaned objects
Cross-reference with database asset registry
Purge verified orphan objects and log audit trail
cases.expected_result: Orphan objects purged from storage bucket, zero orphan objects verified, audit log recorded
cases.security_invariant: SEC-CLN-01: Orphaned storage objects must be reconciled and deleted automatically
cases.evidence_required: Reconciliation sweeper audit summary log

cases.preconditions: HTML content item transitioned to published lifecycle state
cases.input: Student requests lesson content items GET /api/v1/lessons/{id}/contents
steps: Authenticate as student assigned to lesson with can_access_lesson=true
Request lesson content list
Verify item presence
cases.expected_result: Published content item IS returned, sandboxed iframe URL generated successfully with signed token
cases.security_invariant: SEC-VIS-02: Published assets are visible to authorized students via sandboxed origin-isolated paths
cases.evidence_required: API response payload containing published status item and signed iframe token
